questions: Reproduce source section 2.8 and distinguish useful effective rungs from repeated dispatches.
Compare per-provider evidence with cumulative failure counts and reset semantics.
decision: Introduce a pure effective-dispatch ladder model with provider-local evidence; keep the legacy path unchanged until the opt-in switch policy is integrated.
code_observations: choose_route derives a provider slot from total functional failures, whereas availability.select rebuilds a chain for the escalated tier. This can mismatch the ladder and dispatched provider.
The current exhaustion decision uses accumulated failure classes against a later provider's ladder, allowing that provider to be considered exhausted before its first attempt.
A logical tier/effort increase can resolve to the same model and native effort, especially with embedded effort slugs and equal strong/max models.

symbols.name: ## 1. Classify the leaf, then look up the floor

implementation_steps: Define an effective route identity after tier lifting, effort clamping, snapshot resolution and workload-profile resolution. Include the actual backend/quota identity but never secret values.
Build distinct useful rungs with their originating logical tiers. Collapse no-op effective dispatches without reordering different models.

Evaluate failure evidence per provider and phase; retain a task-wide attempt budget as a separate invariant. Define an explicit one-repeat exception for mechanical/budget failures, not arbitrary repeated top attempts.
Add pure legacy replay fixtures reproducing the original section2.8 sequences. New behavior must be gated; do not change existing disabled-mode assertions to make tests pass.
Limit this task to primitives and tests. Tasks070-081 own configuration, state migration, runner integration and handoff so the same feature is not implemented twice.
proposed_acceptance_tests: Equal resolved model/native effort produces one useful rung.
An empty logical tier lifts upward without lowering the requested capability floor.
Evidence from providerA cannot exhaust providerB before B executes.
Environmental, plan_defect and timeout_ceiling failures do not drive capability switching.
Reset behavior and design-phase accounting are explicit, tested and separate from quota cooldowns.

alternatives.title: Fixed four-failure provider slots
alternatives.tradeoff: Cheap but repeats no-op tops and can skip eligible providers.

alternatives.title: Distinct dispatch ladder with local evidence
alternatives.tradeoff: Deterministic and explainable; integration is guarded by an opt-in contract.

alternatives.title: Always jump to the most expensive model after any error
alternatives.tradeoff: Confuses environment faults with capability and wastes attempts/cost.

cost_model: Evaluate avoided identical dispatches, provider reachability and success per total attempt cost. Offline replay proves route properties only, not real task success or monetary savings.
unverified: Quality equivalence across providers is not established by matching tier labels. Real-run calibration remains an authorized evaluation step.
runtime_experiments: No authenticated model calls; tests listed here are implementation obligations, not claimed passes.
